Class ActivityReportService

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.report.ActivityReportService
@Service public class ActivityReportService extends Object
Builds commercial analysts' activity reports: trade counts, buy/sell totals and volume over a period, broken down by UTC day or ISO week. Only FILLED orders count.

    • getActivityReport

      public ActivityReport getActivityReport(LocalDate from, LocalDate to, ReportGranularity granularity, UUID instrumentId)
      Builds the activity report for a period.
      Parameters:
      from - the first UTC day of the period, inclusive
      to - the last UTC day of the period, inclusive
      granularity - whether to break the period down by day or by ISO week
      instrumentId - the instrument to report on, or null for all instruments
      Returns:
      the report; its buckets are empty when nothing traded in the period
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the period or instrument is invalid
